post.news: Amazon cut its Q3 sales and marketing spend by 8% to $762 million, while its ad revenue grew 11%.
post.take: Spend less on your own ads, charge everyone else more to run theirs. Peak landlord behaviour.
post.insight: Marketplaces with captive buyer attention do not need heavy marketing; they monetize by selling shelf space to others.
